malicious_evidence: Corgea retrieved the exact @leadstack/crm-connect 1.0.15 archive from npmmirror and matched its SHA-256 to SafeDep. legitimate_tool_review: Independent review confirms the hash identifies the custom malicious CRM package archive. Genuine Hermes Agent, its npm runtime wrapper, systemd and other administration/security tools are excluded; their ordinary bytes are not indicators.
limitations: Actual mirror retrieval is bounded between the 2026-11-16 release and this 2026-11-22 review; its exact UTC day is unpublished, so the UTC delivery field is empty. Registry release timestamps are not asserted as retrieval times. Corgea published on November 20 and SafeDep on November 19. Possible private availability before the public mirror trace is unconfirmed. The operator configuration/persona was not recovered; victim execution and successful compromise were not demonstrated. The system-service path requires an installation already running as root; it does not itself elevate privileges. Current availability is not claimed. During this collection only public reports were reviewed; no package or attacker endpoint was retrieved or executed.
